summary: Enhance your expertise with our Supervisory Frameworks for Central Banks Training Course. Gain essential skills to navigate regulatory challenges effectively.
lede: Central bank supervision training focuses on turning policy and prudential standards into evidence-based oversight. It is for bank supervision officers, examiners, surveillance teams and policy staff who need to assess risks, plan monitoring and inspections, and follow up on weaknesses. Participants practise building risk profiles and early-warning indicators, gathering evidence and writing actionable findings, and designing remediation or escalation plans.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who need to enhance their supervisory practices and ensure financial stability.
audience: Central bank policy and regulation staff
modules: The Role of Supervision in Financial Stability
Building Blocks of a Supervisory Framework
Off-Site Supervision and Early Warning Signals
Capital Adequacy and Prudential Standards in Practice
Supervisory Reporting, Documentation, and Quality Assurance
Supervising Emerging Risks and Financial Innovation
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial supervision and regulatory principles. Prior experience in bank supervision or a related regulatory role is recommended.
